headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Gate Struggle Widens
war_summary: Since the last edition the wires report a sharp renewal in the Weathered Expanse with eleven changes in two hours to 20:55 for twenty-eight on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk at four Warden to five Colonial alongside accelerating casualty rates, while Linn Mercy shows three changes to 20:20 for twelve on the day about Rotdust at one Warden to ten Colonial and Marban Hollow shows three changes to 20:20 about Mox for eight Colonial, with Deadlands adding three changes in two hours to 19:55 for six on the day about Callahan's Gate now standing eleven Colonial. Stlican Shelf with twenty-seven on the day to 19:10 about Fort Hoarfrost at four Warden to five Colonial and Stonecradle with sixteen on the day to 17:30 have gone quiet in the last two hours, as have Fisherman's Row with thirty-seven on the day to 13:15, Farranac Coast with six to 15:44 and Mooring County with nine to 15:44 despite heavy and accelerating losses there. Godcrofts remains the busiest board with seventy-three on the day to 19:29 about The Axehead for nine Colonial, with a single change in the last two hours.
